eligibility.en: Applicant and parents must be non-Korean; foreign nationality before high-school study. Dual Korean nationality is excluded. Special family situations require government evidence.
eligibility.ko: 지원자·부모 모두 외국 국적이며 고교 교육 시작 전 외국 국적 취득 요건이 있습니다. 한국 복수국적은 제외되며 가족관계 예외는 정부 증빙이 필요합니다.

eligibility.en: High-school graduation or expected graduation; nonstandard schooling and equivalency certificates have exclusions.
eligibility.ko: 고교 졸업 또는 졸업예정자. 검정·비정규 교육 인정 제외 사항을 확인해야 합니다.

language.en: Korean-track alternatives: TOPIK PBT/IBT level 3; qualifying Korean university language course level 3; Sejong Institute Intermediate-3B; Ajou Korean proficiency test pass. English-track business thresholds do not apply to engineering.

documents.en: Signed application, consent/agreement forms, activity list and evidence, authenticated graduation certificate and all-year transcript, applicant passport, parent identity and family relationship evidence, language proof. ARC and Korean-language-institute records are conditional.

documents.en: Non-Korean/English documents need notarized translation. Apostille/consular and China-specific verification rules apply. Family relationship evidence must be issued within one year.
documents.ko: 한국어·영어 외 서류는 번역공증 필요. 아포스티유·영사확인 및 중국 학력 인증 규칙 적용. 가족관계 증빙은 지원일 기준 1년 이내 발급.
